scripts.build: pnpm clean && ncc build src/index.ts -o dist && babel dist --out-dir dist && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('images', 'dist/images', { recursive: true }); require('fs').copyFileSync('plugin.json', 'dist/plugin.json')"
scripts.package: pnpm build && cd dist && zip -r ../wox-plugin-localsend.wox *.js *.json images
scripts.dev: nodemon --watch src --watch images --watch plugin.json --ext json,ts,js,mjs,png --exec pnpm run build
scripts.clean:all: pnpm run clean && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('node_modules', { recursive: true, force: true })"
